loc_forge.name: Vane's Forge
loc_forge.short_desc: Cotter Vane's forge, and the only home you remember clearly.
loc_forge.long_desc: The fire is banked but never out. Three years of your own work hangs on the far wall — the early pieces crooked, the later ones not — and Cotter has never once taken them down or mentioned that he has not. The good hammer lives on the third peg, and only you and he are allowed to touch it.

features.name: The forge hearth
features.desc: Banked but never out, and the stone under it does not sit flush.

interactions.label: Search under the hearth stone

on_success.text: The hearth stone at Vane's forge lifts, and there is a cavity under it.

interactions.narrate: The stone lifts a finger's width before it grinds.

interactions.label: Bank the fire down
interactions.narrate: Ash over the coals. It will keep until morning.

features.name: Your own work on the wall
features.desc: Three years of it, the early pieces crooked, the later ones not.

interactions.label: Take a bar of your own stock
interactions.narrate: Yours to take, and always was.

interactions.label: Look properly at what you have made
interactions.narrate: The joins got tighter every winter.

features.name: The anvil
features.desc: Scarred, and worth more than the roof over it.

interactions.label: Work a piece at the anvil
interactions.narrate: Heat, hammer, quench. An hour goes without asking.

loc_green.name: The Green
loc_green.short_desc: The green, the well, and the moot stone nobody remembers the carving on.
loc_green.long_desc: Wickmoor is arranged around this the way a hand closes around a coin. The well at the centre, the moot stone beside it worn smooth enough that the carving is a rumour, and a Syndicate lamp on a new iron post that the village paid for twice — once in the levy and once in the arguing.

features.name: The moot stone
features.desc: Older than the hall, and nobody has ever moved it.

interactions.label: Read the cut marks on the moot stone

on_success.text: The moot stone carries older marks than the Syndicate's: this was a holding before it was a parish.

interactions.narrate: Under the lichen, older strokes.

interactions.label: Stand up on the moot stone
interactions.narrate: From up here you can see the whole green at once.

features.name: The village well
features.desc: Deep, cold, and the windlass rope is fraying.

interactions.label: Look down the well
interactions.narrate: Black water a long way down, and something pale on the ledge.

interactions.label: Climb down the well rope
interactions.narrate: The rope is older than you are.

then.text: Halla and Dunn Wick died in the burning of Wickmoor.

loc_bakehouse.name: The Bakehouse
loc_bakehouse.short_desc: Gower's bakehouse, warm at hours when nothing else in Wickmoor is.
loc_bakehouse.long_desc: Old Gower bakes at four and is asleep by seven, which means the bakehouse between those hours belongs to his daughter and whoever she has not yet thrown out of it. The ovens hold their heat until midday. Half the village comes through and none of them are hurrying.

features.name: The bread oven
features.desc: Big enough to stand in, and warm long after it is out.

on_success.text: Somebody has been sleeping in Nell Gower's oven when it is out.

interactions.label: Get inside the oven
interactions.narrate: Soot and warmth, and nobody looks in an oven.

loc_moot_hall.name: The Moot Hall
loc_moot_hall.short_desc: A long low hall with a good roof, which in Wickmoor counts as grandeur.
loc_moot_hall.long_desc: Older than anything else standing here, and better built, which is the sort of thing you stop noticing about a place you grew up in. The elders sit at the north end under a beam somebody carved a long time ago and somebody else, later, planed most of the way flat.

exits.desc: behind the elders' dais, behind a nailed board

features.name: The parish chest
features.desc: Three locks, and the parish only ever had two keys.

on_success.text: The parish chest holds the lamp-tithe rolls going back eleven years.
The third lock on the parish chest is new, and Syndicate-stamped.

features.name: The roll board
features.desc: Every household in the parish, and what it owes.

on_success.text: The Wick household is entered twice on the parish rolls, in two different hands.

loc_riverbend.name: The Riverbend
loc_riverbend.short_desc: Where the Wick turns and slows, and the fish are stupid enough to be catchable.
loc_riverbend.long_desc: The bank shelves gently here and the water goes quiet and brown-green under the alders. Four of you have been coming to this bend since you were small enough to be carried to it.

features.name: The gravel shelf
features.desc: Where the current drops what it is carrying.

on_success.text: The river brings down milled timber from somewhere upstream that has no mill.

interactions.label: Set the lines and wait
interactions.narrate: Not much of a catch, but it passes the afternoon.

then.text: Sibby saw the smoke first. She always sees it first.
Smoke over the valley, and an hour of running between you and it.

loc_high_wood.name: The High Wood
loc_high_wood.short_desc: The rise above the river, where you can see the whole valley and everyone in it.
loc_high_wood.long_desc: Beech and old ash, and a gap in them at the top where three generations of Wickmoor children have climbed to look down at their own roofs and feel briefly enormous.

features.name: The deadfall
features.desc: Storm-thrown timber nobody has cleared in two winters.

on_success.text: Somebody has been camping in the High Wood deadfall, and recently.

interactions.label: Get up above the deadfall
interactions.narrate: From the leaning trunk you can see the North Road.

loc_north_road.name: The North Road
loc_north_road.short_desc: The cart road to Harrowmoot, two days at a walk and rutted the whole way.
loc_north_road.long_desc: The Syndicate resurfaced the first mile of it eight years ago and then stopped, which everyone in Wickmoor can show you the exact spot of.

exits.desc: two days, and the ruts get worse

features.name: The churned verge
features.desc: Where the paving ends and the mud keeps a record.

interactions.label: Read the tracks in the verge

on_success.text: Eight horses went north off the Wickmoor cut, shod alike, carrying weight.

interactions.label: Search the ditch along the road

on_success.text: A Syndicate transit warrant, torn across, was dropped in the North Road ditch.

features.name: The Syndicate milestone
features.desc: Fresh-cut, and it does not agree with the old one.

on_success.text: The Syndicate has re-measured the road, and Wickmoor is now four miles further from Harrowmoot than it was.

then.text: Something answered Jory on the north road, and it used his name.

then.subject: cmp_jory
then.reason: you saw it happen and did not leave

loc_undercroft.name: The Undercroft
loc_undercroft.short_desc: A dry stone room beneath the moot hall that should not be as old as it is.
loc_undercroft.long_desc: The stair down is behind the elders' dais and has been behind a nailed board for as long as anyone alive has been looking at it. The room below is dressed stone, cut better than anything above ground, and it is dry. It has always been dry.

features.name: The stores
features.desc: What the parish keeps for a bad winter, and a bad winter has not come.

on_success.text: The parish stores are short by more than one winter's worth.

ambient.smell: cold stone, and no damp at all

loc_tollgate.name: The Harrowmoot Tollgate
loc_tollgate.short_desc: A gate, a ledger, and a queue of people explaining themselves.
loc_tollgate.long_desc: Harrowmoot grew up around a crossing and never stopped charging for it. The gate is Syndicate work — clean iron, a lamp on either post, and a clerk under an awning who has asked the same four questions so many times he no longer hears the answers. The queue moves. That is the thing people mean when they say the Syndicate runs it well.

features.name: The toll ledger
features.desc: Open on its stand, and everyone who passes goes in it.

on_success.text: The tollgate ledger logs every name through the gate, and the last four days are written in one hand.

interactions.label: Put a false name in the ledger

on_success.text: There is a name in the Harrowmoot toll ledger that was never at the gate.

features.name: The gate bar
features.desc: Iron-bound oak, and two wardens on the winch.

interactions.label: Listen to the wardens on the gate

on_success.text: The Harrowmoot gate wardens change on the third bell and do not overlap.

ambient.sound: a clerk saying 'business in the town'

then.text: Lamp oil costs less at the Harrowmoot gate than it ever did in Wickmoor.

loc_assay_row.name: Assay Row
loc_assay_row.short_desc: Where contracts are weighed, stamped, and made true.
loc_assay_row.long_desc: Three storeys of clean stone and small windows, and a smell of hot wax that gets into your clothes. Everything that burns in forty miles is priced in this street. The people going in and out are not rich; they work for people who are.

features.name: The filing presses
features.desc: Third press, lower shelf, twelve hundred and forty-two.

on_success.text: Assay Row files closed bonds separately, and the closed drawer has its own lock.

interactions.label: Read what is left out on the bench

on_success.text: Wickmoor's lamp-tithe was assessed twice in one year, under two different bond numbers.

loc_fetterlock.name: The Fetterlock
loc_fetterlock.short_desc: An inn named after the thing that holds a horse, which its owner thinks is funny.
loc_fetterlock.long_desc: Two rooms and a yard, and Rue Tamsin has run it long enough that the regulars have regular chairs. It is the only place in Harrowmoot where an Arcanate pensioner and a Syndicate clerk will drink in the same room, mostly because Rue does not permit otherwise and is larger than either of them.

features.name: The card table
features.desc: A bad hand slapped down, and money that is not being counted.

interactions.label: Watch the table without sitting down

on_success.text: The card game at the Fetterlock is a cover for handing over stamped paper.

interactions.label: Sit in on a hand
interactions.narrate: You lose a little, on purpose, and they talk.

features.name: The cellar hatch
features.desc: Behind the zinc counter, and it is not bolted from this side.

interactions.label: Lift the cellar hatch
interactions.narrate: Cold air, and a smell of river.

on_success.text: Something is moved through the Fetterlock cellar at night, and it is not barrels.

loc_pensioners_hall.name: The Pensioners' Hall
loc_pensioners_hall.short_desc: An Arcanate licensing hall that stopped licensing anything eleven years ago.
loc_pensioners_hall.long_desc: It was built to impress and it still does, from a distance. The examination floor is full of beds now. The men and women in them were certified practitioners of a discipline that no longer exists, and every one of them can tell you the number of the pension they were promised and the date it stopped.

features.name: The cold braziers
features.desc: Arcanate issue, and not one of them lit.

on_success.text: The Pensioners' Hall braziers are Arcanate work, and they were not put out — they were drained.

interactions.label: Try to bring a brazier up

on_success.text: An Arcanate brazier will still take a charge, eleven years after the seals came off.

features.name: The ward rolls
features.desc: Who is owed, and for what, in a hand that gave up halfway.

on_success.text: The Pensioners' Hall register stops taking new names the year the Accord ended.

loc_the_cut.name: The Cut
loc_the_cut.short_desc: The lanes behind the Row, where the tithe is not collected because nobody has tried twice.
loc_the_cut.long_desc: Four streets the Syndicate surveyed, priced, and quietly left alone. There is a lamp at each end of it and none in the middle, which everyone who lives here understands to be a sentence rather than an oversight.

features.name: The dead lamp
features.desc: One at each end of the Cut and none in the middle.

on_success.text: The middle lamps of the Cut were not broken. The tithe was simply never paid on them.

interactions.label: Get up the lamp post
interactions.narrate: From the crossbar you can see down the whole lane.

features.name: The salt drain grate
features.desc: Iron, rusted thin at the hinge, and the run-off under it turns black.

interactions.label: Pry up the drain grate

on_success.text: The salt drains under the Cut run all the way to the slips.

interactions.narrate: The hinge goes with a crack you feel in your teeth.

on_success.text: There are chains moving somewhere under the Cut, on the bells.

ambient.sound: a door closing somewhere ahead of you

loc_undercroft_row.name: Under Assay Row
loc_undercroft_row.short_desc: Where every contract in forty miles is kept, in the dark, at a controlled temperature.
loc_undercroft_row.long_desc: Brick barrel vaults under the Row, cold enough that your breath shows in high summer. The ledgers stand in iron presses, spine out, each one stamped with the year it was closed. There is a lamp bracket every eight feet and not one lamp lit — fire down here would cost the Syndicate more than a warehouse.

features.name: The closed-bond vault
features.desc: Syndicate iron, and a lock that was made in Harrowmoot.

on_success.text: The closed-bond vault under Assay Row was locked by a Harrowmoot smith, not a Syndicate one.

interactions.label: Work the vault lock
interactions.narrate: Four wards, and the fourth is newer than the rest.

loc_waterline.name: The Waterline
loc_waterline.short_desc: Where the Cut meets the barges, and where things leave Harrowmoot without being weighed.
loc_waterline.long_desc: A stone quay black with oil, four barges deep, and a crane that has not been inspected in living memory. Everything the Row stamps goes out from here; so does everything it never saw. The water moves slowly and smells of lamp-oil and rope.

features.name: The slips crane
features.desc: Heavy timber over the bilge, chains hanging, not inspected in living memory.

interactions.label: Climb the crane frame
interactions.narrate: The catwalk runs above the whole quay.

interactions.label: Cut the crane chain

on_success.text: The slips crane will not lift until somebody replaces the chain.

interactions.narrate: It goes into the bilge with a sound the whole quay hears.

on_success.text: The slips crane housing has a gap where the salt rotted the floorboards out.

features.name: The barges
features.desc: Four deep, and everything the Row never saw goes out on them.

on_success.text: A barge on the Waterline is carrying crates stamped with an Accord mark eleven years out of date.
The night load at the Waterline goes out on the tide, and the wardens are gone before it does.

loc_lamp_house.name: The Bonding House
loc_lamp_house.short_desc: Where lamp-oil stops being a liquid and starts being a contract.
loc_lamp_house.long_desc: Vats on a stone floor, a rail of brass taps, and a smell that makes your eyes water for the first ten minutes and then stops entirely, which is worse. Every barrel leaves here bonded: sealed, stamped, and worth four times what went in.

features.name: The bonding ledger
features.desc: Bound, stamped, and chained to its stand.

on_success.text: Every lamp-tithe bond in the Bonding House is counter-signed by the same hand.

interactions.label: Cut the ledger from its chain

on_success.text: The Bonding House ledger is missing, and they will know who took it.

loc_wickmoor_after.name: Wickmoor, After
loc_wickmoor_after.long_desc: The green is still the green. That is the part nobody warns you about. The bakehouse wall stands to shoulder height and the ovens are intact and cold, and someone has stacked what could be saved into neat piles, which means somebody came back before you did.

features.name: The burnt thatch
features.desc: What is left of the row, and it is still warm.

on_success.text: The fires at Wickmoor were set from inside the houses, not thrown onto the roofs.

interactions.label: Dig out what can be saved
interactions.narrate: An hour on your knees for very little.

loc_counting_house.name: The Counting House
loc_counting_house.short_desc: Four clerks, one door, and the only set of keys in Harrowmoot that matter.
loc_counting_house.long_desc: Smaller than you expected and much quieter. Four desks, four clerks, and a strongroom door that was fitted by somebody who was paid properly. Amery Vosk's contract will close in this room, on paper, with a stamp, and nobody outside will hear a thing.

features.name: The counting strongbox
features.desc: Bolted through the floor, and the floor is stone.

on_success.text: The Counting House strongbox is emptied nightly and carried out the back.

loc_high_moor.name: The High Moor
loc_high_moor.short_desc: Between the two towns, with nothing on it but weather and the road.
loc_high_moor.long_desc: Heather to the knee and a wind that does not stop. The north road runs across it on a raised causeway built by somebody's empire, and if anyone is coming the other way you will see them for twenty minutes before you meet them. That cuts both ways.

features.name: The cairn
features.desc: Somebody keeps it, and nobody admits to it.

on_success.text: The High Moor cairn is kept, and there is fresh stone on it.

interactions.label: Lie up and watch the moor road

on_success.text: Riders use the High Moor at night and carry no lamps.
